coverage_notes: No new clauses added: existing immutable anchors cover the expressible permissions and restrictions in the target paragraphs. The remaining §2.1 actions identified in P0007 have no faithful mapping to the fixed activity vocabulary.

paragraph_audit.reason: The existing anchors cover the mapped grant permissions. The grant also expressly covers making, displaying, performing, having made, importing, and otherwise exploiting or transferring contributions or contributor versions; those actions have no exact mapping in the allowed activities.
The existing anchors cover §2.3’s limitation to expressly granted rights, no implied additional rights, and the patent and contributor-mark limitations stated in lines 40–45.
The existing anchor covers the patent-grant exclusions in lines 42–44 and the absence of trademark, service-mark, and logo rights, subject to the §3.4 notice exception in line 45.
